review_evidence: README identifies the repository as the DM861 Concurrency Theory course.

Six of nine Lean files contain proposition declarations; SimpleProcesses.lean develops process/network syntax, transition relations and algebraic laws such as parallel commutativity/associativity and support/removal behavior.
The source is pedagogical, but it contains independently useful formal semantics and proofs, which the filtering contract preserves.
summary: Reviewed itc-course; retain its concurrency/process-calculus teaching formalization.
